newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital buyback extension okayed.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital buyback extension okayed.

text.p: Security Capital Corp said Friday it received approval from Wisconsin officials to extend a previously announced share repurchase program for an additional three-month period.
Approval was received from the Wisconsin Department of Financial Institutions, Division of Savings Institutions.

Security Capital said it has not completed the repurchase of all of the authorized five percent of outstanding share, or 465,718 shares, under a fourth repurchase program that began on August 7, 1996.
To date, the company said, it has repurchased 140,500 shares at an average price of $63.03 each.
Security Capital, a financial services holding company that owns Security Bank SSB, said it has repurchased a total of 1,510,235 shares during its previous three repurchase programs.
